title: Manhood, the Father Wound, and Raising Sons
subtitle: Two essays, a study, and a book — from a man raised without a father, raising five sons.
forWhom: For the man carrying a wound he never named, and for anyone raising a boy toward a manhood the culture keeps counterfeiting.

items.blurb: What it takes to form a boy when every easy model of manhood on offer is a counterfeit.
